iteration_5.reference_description: Close-up of a dropper bottle closure showing a large, soft dark-plum/mauve rubber pipette bulb with a rounded dome top and a wide skirt that flares over a tall, highly polished rose-gold metallic collar/cap. The bulb is prominent, occupying roughly half the visible height. The collar is cylindrical, wide, and reflective with a warm gold tone. No bottle body is visible.
iteration_5.output_description: Full-bottle synthetic render showing a rectangular flat-sided bottle body in off-white/cream. The closure consists of a small beige/tan stepped collar (two-tier cylindrical cap) surmounted by a small dark-plum flat-topped cylindrical rubber bulb. The bulb is disproportionately small, flat-topped rather than dome-shaped, and the collar is beige/tan with no metallic finish whatsoever.
iteration_5.top_component_observed_shape: Small flat-topped cylinder (dark plum) sitting on a two-step beige cylindrical collar

component_semantics.evidence: A dark plum element is present at the top suggesting a rubber bulb, but its shape is flat-cylindrical rather than the large rounded dome seen in the reference; it lacks the characteristic rounded top and wide flared skirt of the reference bulb

visual_findings: Reference bulb is large, dome-topped, dark plum with wide flared skirt; generated bulb is small, flat-topped, and cylindrical with no flare
Reference collar is tall, wide, highly polished rose-gold metallic; generated collar is beige/tan matte with stepped profile — no metallic finish
Generated bulb height is approximately 20% of closure height vs ~55% in reference
Generated Image 2 is nearly identical to rejected Image 3; minimal or no improvement between iterations
Bottle body in generated render is rectangular/flat-sided; reference shows no body but implies a cylindrical or round-shouldered bottle
Color palette of collar is completely wrong (beige vs rose-gold)
critical_blockers: Bulb shape wrong: flat cylinder instead of large rounded dome
Collar color/material wrong: beige matte instead of rose-gold polished metal
Bulb-to-collar proportion wrong: bulb is far too small relative to collar
No improvement from previously rejected iteration — essentially same render
Flared skirt on bulb absent entirely

visualizer.conflict: VQ_MULTIMODAL_NUMERIC_CLAIM_CONFLICT — model claims a flat top; apex half-width is exactly 0 and dome-only max distance is 0.033. Deterministic measurement governs.

suppliers.subject: 30 ml cylindrical serum bottle + dropper closure — technical specification request
suppliers.body:
Hello,

BBROSE is specifying packaging for a premium 30 ml serum: a frosted cylindrical glass bottle with a rose-gold-appearance metallic dropper closure. We need manufacturer specification data.

Could you provide, for one exact product variant:

  - exact 30 ml cylindrical frosted-glass serum bottle SKU
  - product-variant page or catalogue reference
  - bottle dimensional drawing
  - bottle outside diameter
  - bottle height without closure
  - neck finish
  - neck outside diameter
  - brimful/overflow capacity
  - glass weight
  - compatible dropper closure SKU
  - closure technical drawing
  - collar outside diameter
  - collar visible height
  - dark outer component construction (bare rubber bulb / integral bulb-and-skirt / decorative outer cover / complete overcap / other)
  - pipette length
  - total assembled height
  - bottle material
  - closure materials
  - compatible decoration methods
  - CAD/PDF files
  - MOQ
  - sample availability
  - sample cost
  - lead time
  - country of manufacture

Please state clearly whether any total-height figure INCLUDES the closure.

A dimensional drawing or CAD file is the most useful single item. We are at the specification stage and are not placing an order or requesting a quotation at this time.

Thank you.
suppliers.rights_note: public contact endpoint only; no scraped private addresses; no credentials stored
